hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d10 (or 6) + your Constitution modifier per ranger level after 1st

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You have significant experience studying, tracking, and hunting a particular type of creature common in your home region. Choose one type of favored enemy from the SRD 5.2 list (Aberrations, Beasts, Celestials, Constructs, Dragons, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Giants, Monstrosities, Oozes, Plants, Undead). You have advantage on Survival checks to track them, and on INT checks to recall information about them.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: You are adept at traveling and surviving in your favored terrain (Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Swamp, or Underdark). You gain benefits: difficult terrain doesn't slow your group, your group can't get lost except by magical means, you are always alert, you can find food/water for your group, and you learn an additional language.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a fighting style: Archery, Defense, Dueling, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: By 2nd level, you can cast Ranger spells (Wisdom).

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.description: You choose an archetype: Hunter or Beast Master.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.description: You can use your action to magically sense the presence of aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead within 1 mile (6 miles if outdoors) and learn whether they are stronger/equal/weaker than you, plus the relative number. You can use this a number of times equal to WIS mod (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one score by 2 or two by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: You learn an additional favored enemy, and you gain an additional language.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
features.description: You choose an additional favored terrain.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. You also have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement.

features.name: Nature's Veil (Optional 9th-level feature)
features.description: You can use a bonus action to become magically invisible to your favored enemies for 1 minute (recharges on short/long rest).

features.name: Nature's Veil (Optional, useable at 10+)
features.description: You can use this feature an additional time per rest, both uses don't need to be expended in the same rest.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.description: You can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You have advantage on Stealth checks, and remain hidden even if you have low cover, until you move or take an action/bonus/reaction (other than Hide).

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement (14th)
features.description: You also gain advantage on attack rolls against your favored enemies.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement (18th)
features.description: Favored enemies have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a favored enemy with an attack, you can add 1d6 + WIS mod to damage (or to attack).

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: Few Rangers can match the Beast Master for skill in training and bonding with the natural world. Many Rangers devote themselves to caring for a single companion animal.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: You gain a beast companion from the SRD companion list (CR up to 1/4, no flying/swim). It uses its own stats but obeys commands. As an action, you can have it attack on its turn. If you spend an attack, you can have it make one attack of its own. It shares your initiative count.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Your companion can use your proficiency bonus instead of its own for attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws on rolls it is proficient in. It gains proficiency in any two skills of your choice.

features.name: Beast of the Land (7th)
features.description: Your companion gains additional movement (swim 40 ft becomes part of it; also climbs), gains a +2 bonus to AC, DEX save, and CON save, and proficiency in all saving throws. Its attacks count as magical.

features.name: Beast of the Air (11th)
features.description: Your companion gains a flying speed of 60 feet. (Prerequisite: primate companion or other air-capable companion post-7th rest.)

features.name: Wild Companion (Bonus Action)
features.description: You can summon a different primal companion as a bonus action, lasting 1 hour. Once the summoned companion drops to 0 HP, you cannot use this feature for a short rest.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker

features.name: Dreadful Strike
features.description: First attack each combat: +1d8 damage.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Darkvision 60 ft; invisible to darkvision alone when in darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Advantage on saves vs. fear.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Bonus action to attack twice once per short rest.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: Reaction when missed: attack the attacker.

subclasses.description: You learned to fight in darkness, an ambush predator lurking in the longest shadows.

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: Bonus: deal +1d8 force damage to aberration / fey / elemental targets until turn end.

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: Cast Etherealness on self and allies.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: Bonus action teleport 10 ft before attack.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: Reaction to give ally resistance to BPS from attack.

subclasses.description: You guard the borders between worlds, hunting aberrations that threaten them.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Emulating the Ranger of the Woods, you become an unparalleled predator. Through study and practice, you master fighting techniques that allow you to fell even the fiercest quarry.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose Colossus Slayer (1d8 damage once per turn to injured targets), Giant Killer (reaction attack vs Large or bigger creature that ends its turn within 5 ft of you and that's at least 10 ft away), or Horde Breaker (one extra attack against a different target within 5 ft of your first target).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage), Multiattack Defense (adjacent enemies have disadvantage on attack rolls beyond the first), or Steel Will (advantage on saves vs frightened).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Choose Volley (attack each creature of your choice in a 15-ft radius with ranged attack) or Whirlwind Attack (attack each creature of your choice in melee reach). Cast both at the start of your turn if you have movement remaining.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: Choose Evasion (DEX save halves damage and avoids on save success), Stand Against the Tide (reaction attack vs Large+ that attacks you with advantage on the original roll), or Uncanny Dodge (reaction reduce damage from a creature you can see by half).

subclasses.name: Maestro de bestias
subclasses.description: Pocos exploradores igualan al Maestro de bestias en el entrenamiento y vínculo con el mundo natural.

features.name: Compañero primal
features.description: Obtienes una bestia compañera del SRD (ND ≤ 1/4, sin volar/nadar inicialmente). Usa tu iniciativa, comparte tu bonificador de competencia.

features.name: Bestia de la tierra
features.description: Tu compañero gana +2 CA y salvaciones, competencia en todas las salvaciones y ataques mágicos.

features.name: Bestia del aire
features.description: Gana velocidad de vuelo de 18 m.

subclasses.name: Cazador
subclasses.description: Emulando al cazador del bosque, te conviertes en un depredador sin igual.

features.name: Presa del cazador
features.description: Elige una técnica: Cazador de colosos (1d8 una vez por turno contra herido), Matagigantes (reacción contra Grande+), o Rompehordas (un ataque extra contra objetivo adyacente).

features.name: Tácticas defensivas
features.description: Escapa de la horda, Defensa multiataque, o Voluntad de acero.
